name: Holmes County, OH
findings: Holmes County has 103 nonprofit organizations. 35 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Holmes County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
40% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 8 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 52% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few social and fraternal organizations list membership
observations.text: 3 social and fraternal organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 7 would.

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 52% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through social and fraternal groups? Where else does that happen?
